mapped.math: A SPARQL Basic Graph Pattern is a finite conjunction of RDF triple patterns. RWIL stores witnessed RDF-ish triples as eavt(entity, attribute, value, time), so each BGP triple lowers to an eavt atom with existential time and the whole BGP lowers to a Datalog conjunctive query.
mapped.answerCompleteness: Completeness is governed by the knowledge order <=k: the query returns all bindings witnessed by the current EAVT extent. A top cell is told-both and must surface both witnessed sides, not collapse to one value.

lawTests: SPARQL BGP SELECT returns exactly the bindings of its derived Datalog read
SPARQL ASK and CONSTRUCT are projections of the same BGP evaluation
a knowledge-top cell is query-complete: both witnessed sides surface as bindings
